query:
UPDATE vehicles v
SET mainImageUrl = (
  SELECT imageUrl 
  FROM vehicle_images 
  WHERE vehicleId = v.id 
  ORDER BY sortOrder ASC 
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE mainImageUrl IS NULL;
